answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to lock a refundable stake bond before it can earn, like a harbor charging every arriving ship a deposit: a lone agent pays once, but an attacker spinning up thousands of fake identities must fund every one, and the bond is slashed when misbehavior is proven. Like a juniper that grows slowly from a single ember, trust then accumulates per identity over verified work, so cheap copies cannot outvote established agents.
